ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.16.3 adds a full runtime Harmony census for the exact Reachability.CanReach overload used by the aggressive profile. When a save enters Playing, RimMT logs every Prefix, Postfix, Transpiler and Finalizer with Harmony owner, priority and exact PatchMethod in one pass, so all remaining compatibility blockers can be audited together instead of discovering one owner per build. V0.4.16.2 Hospitality guest-area coexistence, V0.4.16.1 Pathfinding Framework diagnostics coexistence, VFE Phasing authority, sampled parity validation, per-profile cooldown and the global fuse are retained. The census is diagnostics-only and does not alter reachability results or game state.
